::: {.callout-note .legacy appearance="simple"}
This post is from the site I kept at the Courant Institute (2008–2011). It's kept here as an archive; some links are dead and references are dated.
:::

::: content
Got an email the other day from blogged.com:

> Dear Dr. Matthew,
>
> Our editors recently [reviewed your blog](http://www.blogged.com/blogs/what-the-heck-is-55368.html) and have given it a 7.5 score out of (10) in the recreation category of Blogged.com.\
> This is quite an achievement!
>
> <http://www.blogged.com/directory/education/math>
>
> We evaluated your blog based on the following criteria: Frequency of Updates, Relevance of Content, Site Design, and Writing Style.

I'm happy for the rating, although as far as Frequency of Updates goes, each page clearly marks that the blog has been retired since I moved to NYU. And I have never been able to keep the updates up religiously. Still, I am happy about at least a few of the posts.
:::
